name: measure before release — placeholder budget; 97.96 kB brotli on Linux at main 011e2237b (W10), then 100.04 kB with W4's viewer-first open (D9 pending entries read through the authority under a no-progress stall, `pendingPaths` and pending rows in the index snapshot, and a tree write's expected entries known to the index before they land), about 2.1 kB (brotli on Linux, 2026-11-06; limit raised from 100 kB to 100.3 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7), then 100.49 kB with W3.2's warm open (FileSystemAccessProvider keeps a bounded file-handle cache, so a warm stat is one getFile()), about 0.2 kB (brotli on Linux, 2026-11-07; limit raised from 100.3 kB to 100.5 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7), then 100.53 kB with its review fixes (the cache moves a re-kept or answering handle to the most recent end, and forgets a known file by its one key), about 0.03 kB (brotli on Linux, 2026-11-07; limit raised from 100.5 kB to 100.6 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7), then 101.66 kB with W6.3's sync prerequisites (the Project Index's bounded removal record with its epoch, stored with the snapshot, and `writeFileStream` staged through OPFS sync handles, the writable stream's swap file and Node's synced temp sibling), about 1.13 kB (brotli on Linux, 2026-11-07; limit raised from 100.6 kB to 101.7 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7)
